 Notice of Monthly Town Board Mtg –Tuesday June 17th, 2025 10:30 am 
N OTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a meeting of Town Board of Supervisors of the Town of Hortonia in the County of Outagamie, State of Wisconsin, will be held at the Town Hall W9702  GIVENS ROAD on June 17th, 2025 10:30 am for the purpose of a monthly Town Board meeting. A quorum of Plan Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Appeals may be present in the gallery during the meeting. If a meeting is cancelled due to the weather or other circumstances, a notice of cancellation will be left on the Town WEBSITE. Agenda May be Altered up to 24hrs prior to Meeting and will be posted.

Agenda TBA:
